tower.environments.v1alpha1.BoxImageInpu.description: BoxImageInputs make a box's image, which lives in the registry.

addons.description: Add-ons with their versions, such as "browser@3".

baseImageDigest.description: The image the devcontainer starts from, by digest.

buildHash.description: A hash of the box's ImageBuild, its Dockerfile and files, for an image built from one; base_image_digest and devcontainer_hash are then empty.

devcontainerHash.description: A hash of the resolved devcontainer: devcontainer.json with its features, its Dockerfile, and the files that Dockerfile copies.

tower.environments.v1alpha1.BoxWarmInput.description: BoxWarmInputs make a warm golden: a checkout of a repository's default branch with its toolchain and dependencies installed and pre-built, on the target's disk. Only the most used repositories get one.

lockfilesHash.description: A hash of the lockfiles (go.sum, pnpm-lock.yaml, package-lock.json, uv.lock, Cargo.lock, ...).

prebuildHash.description: A hash of its pre-build: the commands run in it and the repository's root Makefile (docs/decisions/devcontainers.md).

toolchainHash.description: A hash of the toolchain's configuration (mise.toml, .tool-versions).

tower.environments.v1alpha1.GoldenSpec.description: GoldenSpec is what the golden is built from. All of it is fixed.

boxImage.description: Set at most one of boxImage, boxWarm, machine.

boxWarm.description: Set at most one of boxImage, boxWarm, machine.

inputHash.description: The hash of inputs: what makes two goldens the same.

machine.description: Set at most one of boxImage, boxWarm, machine.

parent.description: The Golden a warm golden is made on, its box image; empty otherwise.

tower.environments.v1alpha1.GoldenStatus.description: GoldenStatus is what the golden came to.

artifact.description: What environments are made from: an image reference by digest, a hangar CustomImage, or a hostd snapshot.

lastUseTime.description: When an environment was last made from it: what pruning reads.

phase.description: GoldenPhase is where a golden is in its life.

size.description: What it holds on the target, as a quantity.

blueprintHash.description: A hash of the blueprint's content and its golden_vars.

runAs.description: The user the blueprint runs as (Blueprint.run_as), empty for root.

tower.meta.v1.Condition.description: Condition is one observed aspect of an object's state, such as "Ready".

observedGeneration.description: The generation this condition was computed from.

reason.description: CamelCase machine-readable cause of the last transition.

status.description: ConditionStatus is the state of a condition.

tower.meta.v1.ObjectMeta.description: ObjectMeta is the metadata every resource carries. Users set name, project, labels and annotations; everything else is owned by the system. See docs/decisions/apply-semantics.md.

annotations.description: Keys under a *.tower.hangarlab.cloud/ prefix are reserved for the system.

deleteTime.description: Set when deletion was requested and finalizers are still pending.

generation.description: Incremented on every change to spec.

labels.description: Keys under a *.tower.hangarlab.cloud/ prefix are reserved for the system.

name.description: DNS-1123 label, unique within the project (or the platform, for global kinds). An Invitation's is an email instead.

resourceVersion.description: Store revision of the last write to this object.

tower.meta.v1.OwnerReference.description: OwnerReference points at the object that owns this one. An owner is in the same project, a global object, or, for a global object, one in the project the reference names; when it is deleted, its dependents are garbage collected.

controller.description: The owner is the controller responsible for this object.

project.description: The owner's project, when the owner is project-scoped and this object is global, as a RoleBinding owned by the ServiceToken it names. Empty otherwise.

description: Golden is what environments are made from on one target: a box's image, a warm checkout of a repository with its dependencies, or a converged machine. There is one per target and input hash, shared by every environment of the same inputs; a change of input is a new Golden, and one nothing was made from for a while is pruned. tower's controllers make them; workstream may read them. See docs/decisions/hostd-storage.md.
